description: ResSimpy provides a Python interface to read, modify and write reservoir-simulation input decks. Its documentation includes Nexus model examples and workflow operations. The provider is BP and ResSimpy contributors. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The repository shows Apache 2.0. External simulator licences are separate. Limitations: The library prepares simulator files; it does not establish that every simulator format is supported or execute a reservoir solver by itself. For simulation it supports repeatable preparation and alteration of reservoir models. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this input-deck library.
